hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom curve AMM hook backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. Executes swaps entirely in beforeSwap using a proprietary invariant curve, depositing input tokens into and withdrawing output tokens from Euler vaults via beforeSwapReturnsDelta. Reverts on beforeAddLiquidity and beforeDonate to prevent unproductive liquidity positions and irrecoverable donations.
